Eglantine Game Boy runtime source

Eglantine builds the mGBA 0.10.5 static library with the upstream
`LIBMGBA_ONLY` option. The build excludes mGBA's standalone command-line
parser and prefixes its bundled CRC fallback. The dependency manifest
records the SHA-512 digest of the complete source archive used by this build.

Upstream source, including blip_buf and inih
https://codeload.github.com/mgba-emu/mgba/tar.gz/refs/tags/0.10.5

Upstream revision
26b7884bc25a5933960f3cdcd98bac1ae14d42e2

The Eglantine source for the corresponding release contains the complete
build and integration sources. To rebuild against a modified mGBA source
copy, configure the Eglantine release source with `-Dmgba_CUSTOM_DIR=<source>`
and build the `yuzu-cmd` target. The integration lives in
`src/emulation/classic` and `src/yuzu_cmd/classic_session.cpp`.
